description: Defines the BuzzShareDecorator class which provides methods to manipulate BuzzShare entities, such as setting an employee, increasing or decreasing comment and like counts, within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: BuzzShareDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for BuzzShare entities, providing methods to modify the share's associated employee, comment count, and like count.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the BuzzShareDecorator with a BuzzShare entity.

methods.name: getBuzzShare
methods.description: Protected method that returns the associated BuzzShare entity.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee object on the BuzzShare entity based on employee number.

methods.name: increaseNumOfCommentsByOne
methods.description: Increments the number of comments on the BuzzShare entity by one.

methods.name: decreaseNumOfCommentsByOne
methods.description: Decrements the number of comments on the BuzzShare entity by one.

methods.name: increaseNumOfLikesByOne
methods.description: Increments the number of likes on the BuzzShare entity by one.

methods.name: decreaseNumOfLikesByOne
methods.description: Decrements the number of likes on the BuzzShare entity by one.
